_comment: Retry-query pairs driven through metasalmon's .ms_llm_classify_retry_query() by r-retry-query-verdicts.R; the verdicts land in r-retry-query-verdicts.json. Each case names what it exercises. Every pair here gets the same verdict from metasalmon before and after hub item B-361 point (5), which moves R's duplicate check to ASCII-only case folding; a pair that differs only in a non-ASCII letter's case is deliberately absent, because current R folds it by locale and the ruled verdict (not a duplicate) is pinned by tests/test_retry_query_classifier.py directly.

cases.exercises: case-insensitive duplicate after whitespace collapse and trim
tab and newline collapse to one space
the original query is normalized before the comparison
plain case difference
a different query is usable
no original query to compare with
a missing retry query is invalid
an empty retry query is invalid
a blank retry query is invalid
trimws() strips only space, tab, CR and LF, so a lone vertical tab survives the emptiness check and collapses to an empty usable query
a CURIE whose prefix has an underscore and a digit is identifier-like (the case B-362 names)
a CURIE is identifier-like
R's bracket expression [^\s] excludes the letter s, so a local part containing s is not identifier-like
an uppercase S after the colon is allowed
R's bracket expression [^\s] does not exclude a space
R's bracket expression [^\s] excludes a backslash
the prefix must start with a letter
dots, plus and hyphen are allowed in the prefix
at least one character after the colon
prose with a colon; the local part contains s, so not identifier-like
the prefix class is ASCII letters only
an http IRI is identifier-like
the scheme prefixes match case-insensitively and are prefix matches, so a later space does not matter
urn: prefix
doi: prefix, case-insensitive
doi: is a prefix match
tolower() does not fold sharp s to ss, unlike Python's casefold()
a no-break space is not whitespace to R's \s
an em space is whitespace to R's \s
an ideographic space is whitespace to R's \s
NEL is not whitespace to R's \s
a narrow no-break space is not whitespace to R's \s
